items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2tSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--771666707ad993063a3dbe350b42d58d1d336e8f/cubicle-text-logo-black-trans-2500x375.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png) This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [TheCubicle](https://thecubicle.com). - Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to host our first ever competition in beautiful Marin County! The event is only seven miles north of the Golden Gate Bridge, so come join us! **If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.** - This is a series competition with [Bay Area Speedcubin' 31B - Mill Valley 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC31BMillValley2022/). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for *Bay Area Speedcubin' 31B - Mill Valley 2022*, your registration for this competition will be rejected. - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. If you request more, your registration may be subject to rejection.

items.information: # REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 (inscrição+camiseta) pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento. ------------ **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. Bank Account: Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.

items.information: Twisty Taranaki 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
